007
008public class PersonBountyEventData {
009        
010        public static int BUFFER_DEFAULT = 1;
011        public static int BUFFER_MAX = 3;
012        public static int BUFFER_PER_SUCCESS = 2;
013
014        private List<String> participatingFactions = new ArrayList<String>();
015        
016        private int level = 0;
017        private int successesThisLevel = 0;
018        private int buffer = BUFFER_DEFAULT;
019
020        public PersonBountyEventData() {
021                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.HEGEMONY);
022                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.DIKTAT);
023                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.LUDDIC_CHURCH);
024                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.TRITACHYON);
025                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.INDEPENDENT);
026                addParticipatingFaction(Factions.PERSEAN);
027        }
028
029        public void reportSuccess(int completedLevel) {
030                if (completedLevel < level) {
031                        if (buffer > 0) {
032                                buffer--;
033                        } else {
034                                successesThisLevel--;
035                                // don't overdo toning it down
036//                              if (completedLevel < level - 1) {
037//                                      successesThisLevel--;
038//                              }
039                        }
040                }
041                
042                // do not increment successesThisLevel unless bounty level is higher
043                
044                if (completedLevel >= level + 1) {
045                        buffer += BUFFER_PER_SUCCESS;
046                        successesThisLevel++;
047//                      if (completedLevel >= level + 1) {
048//                              successesThisLevel++;
049//                      }
050                        if (completedLevel >= level + 2) {
051                                successesThisLevel++;
052                                buffer++;
053                        }
054                } else if (completedLevel == level) {
055                        buffer++;
056                }
057                
058                if (buffer > BUFFER_MAX) buffer = BUFFER_MAX;
059                
060                int threshold = getThresholdForLevel(level);
061                if (successesThisLevel >= threshold) {
062                        level++;
063                        successesThisLevel = 0;
064                        buffer = BUFFER_DEFAULT;
065                } else if (successesThisLevel < 0) {
066                        level--;
067                        successesThisLevel = 0;
068                        buffer = BUFFER_DEFAULT;
069                }
070                
071                if (level < 0) level = 0;
072                if (level > 10) level = 10;
073        }
074

076//              if (level == 0) return 2;
077//              if (level == 1) return 2;
078//              if (level == 2) return 3;
079//              
080//              if (level == 3) return 4;

082//              if (level == 5) return 6;
083//              if (level == 6) return 7;
084//              
085//              if (level == 7) return 8;
086//              if (level == 8) return 9;
087//              if (level == 9) return 10;
088//              
089//              return 11; // 67 total
090                
091                if (level == 0) return 2;
092                if (level == 1) return 2;
093                if (level == 2) return 2;
094                
095                if (level == 3) return 2;
096                if (level == 4) return 2;
097                if (level == 5) return 2;
098                if (level == 6) return 2;
099                
100                if (level == 7) return 3;
101                if (level == 8) return 3;
102                if (level == 9) return 3;               
103                
104                return 4;
105//              if (level == 7) return 4;
106//              if (level == 8) return 5;
107//              if (level == 9) return 6;
108//              
109//              return 6; // 39 total
110        }
111        
112        public int getBuffer() {
113                return buffer;
114        }
115
116        public int getLevel() {
117                //if (true) return 10;
118                return level;
119        }
120        
121        public void setLevel(int level) {
122                this.level = level;
123        }
124
125        public void setSuccessesThisLevel(int successesThisLevel) {
126                this.successesThisLevel = successesThisLevel;
127        }
128
129        public List<String> getParticipatingFactions() {
130                return participatingFactions;
131        }
132        
133        public void addParticipatingFaction(String factionId) {
134                participatingFactions.add(factionId);
135        }
136        
137        public void removeParticipatingFaction(String factionId) {
138                participatingFactions.remove(factionId);
139        }
140        
141        public boolean isParticipating(String factionId) {
142                return participatingFactions.contains(factionId);
143        }

145        public int getSuccessesThisLevel() {
